name: Health bar
summary: Game health bar with a heart icon, a red to green fill and a flash and ghost when health drops.

params.name: value
params.note: health 0..1; animate with [1, 0.3] to take damage

params.name: from
params.note: health before this shot; shows the ghost and the damage flash

params.name: label
params.note: optional small text above the bar

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

author: krakujs
